rule: Winning: three tens takes the hand outright. Two each and the trick count decides. All four is a Mendikot (2); every trick is a Whitewash (3).

handEnd.mendikot: Hand over. Team {{team}} took all four tens -- a Mendikot, +2.
handEnd.whitewash: Hand over. Team {{team}} took every trick -- a Whitewash, +3.
